blocks.text: SCHEDULE: UAAP Season 89 basketball tournament – second round ANTIPOLO—NLEX moved on the cusp of ending its string of playoff flameouts after defeating Phoenix, 124-117, for a 2-0 lead in the 2026 PBA Governors’ Cup quarterfinals on Wednesday at Ynares Center here. Schonny Winston and Robert Bolick scored 31 points apiece while import Deonte Burton had 24 points and 10 rebounds as the Road Warriors held off a determined challenge from the Fuel Masters to close in on the sweep of the best-of-five affair.
